# Audit these specs before I trust them

Someone generated specifications from this codebase and I do not want to act on them until
they have been checked.

Go through them and tell me:

- is every public surface actually covered by a scenario, or are there holes
- are the internal paths covered transitively by something
- does every claim carry a real citation, or are some of them assertions
- is anything marked as confirmed that the code does not actually prove
- is anything in here a proposal or an opinion rather than a description

Reject it if it does not hold up. I would rather hear it now.
